settings.title: First Search Marketing in two minutes.

settings.editor: Who we are, the three ways we help local businesses grow, what we believe and the values behind every partnership, in under two minutes.

First Search Marketing is a family-owned digital marketing agency in Hampton, New Hampshire. We help local businesses become the first name their customers find, trust and choose, with the FirstSearch Framework: four stages, one connected system, instead of a pile of tactics.

settings.title: Three ways to work with us

icon_list.text: Let us run it: our agency. Our team becomes your marketing department, running every stage of the framework, from branding and your website to SEO, ads, social, leads and reviews, with plain-English reporting every month. See our services.
Build it with us: coaching. You do the work, with an expert in your corner. One-on-one coaching builds your plan with you and keeps you accountable. See BeFirst Coaching.
Learn it yourself: training. The BeFirst Community, our online course, the FirstSearch Blueprint and live workshops teach you the same system we use with our partners. See BeFirst Training.
Strategy beats size. You don’t need a massive budget to win. You need a proven strategy.
Authenticity always wins. Trust isn’t built through gimmicks. It’s built through consistency.
Growth is a system. Any business can scale by improving the entire customer journey.
Accountability. We take full ownership of every decision, every dollar and every result.
Collaboration. We don’t work for you, we work with you. No black boxes, no surprises.
Curiosity. We stay genuinely invested in your business, always looking for the next way to help you grow.
Partnership. Long-term relationships rooted in trust and transparency, not short-term wins.

settings.editor: Want to know who’s behind it all? Meet the team, or read why local businesses choose us.

settings.title: Let us run it: our agency

tabs.tab_content:
0:00 · Chris: Hi, I’m Chris Mitchell, owner of First Search Marketing. We’re a family-owned digital marketing agency in Hampton, New Hampshire, and we help local businesses become the first name their customers find, trust and choose. Everything we do runs on the FirstSearch Framework: four stages, one connected system.

0:15 · Chris: Most of our partners let us run it. Our team becomes your marketing department, handling your brand, website, SEO, ads, social, leads and reviews, with plain-English reporting every month.

0:32 · Chris: If you’d rather do the work yourself with an expert in your corner, our one-on-one coaching builds your plan with you and keeps you accountable.

0:47 · Chris: And if you want to learn the system on your own, BeFirst Training gives you the online course, the FirstSearch Blueprint, live workshops and our BeFirst Community.

1:02 · Chris: Whichever way you work with us, three beliefs guide everything we do. Strategy beats size: you don’t need a huge budget, you need a clear plan. Authenticity always wins: trust is built through consistency, not gimmicks. And growth is a system: real momentum comes from improving the whole customer journey.

1:22 · Chris: We hold ourselves to four values: accountability for every decision and every dollar, collaboration with no black boxes, curiosity about your business, and partnership for the long term.

1:38 · Chris: That’s First Search Marketing. If you’re ready to put your business first, let’s talk.
